description:
Here's a description of the provided plot, following the guidelines:

The plot illustrates the relationship between TFLOPs and Loss Ratio for different SepLLM configurations, as well as a Vanilla model. The x-axis is labeled “TFLOPs” and is a linear scale ranging from 1e7 to 9e8, with tick labels at intervals of 1e7. The y-axis is labeled “Loss Ratio (%)” and is a linear scale ranging from 94 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 1. The line representing “Vanilla” is purple with triangle markers and shows a steady decline from approximately 99.3 at 1e7 TFLOPs to approximately 98.5 at 9e8 TFLOPs. The line representing “SepLLM (n=64)” is orange with circle markers and begins at approximately 97.2 at 1e7 TFLOPs, increases to approximately 99.6 at 2e7 TFLOPs, then declines to approximately 98.8 at 9e8 TFLOPs. The line representing “SepLLM (n=128)” is blue with cross markers and begins at approximately 97.8 at 1e7 TFLOPs, increases to approximately 99.8 at 2e7 TFLOPs, then declines to approximately 98.7 at 9e8 TFLOPs. The line representing “SepLLM (n=64, H)” is green with diamond markers and shows a steady increase from approximately 97.5 at 1e7 TFLOPs to approximately 99.4 at 5e8 TFLOPs, then declines to approximately 98.9 at 9e8 TFLOPs. The line representing “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)” is red with downward-pointing triangle markers and begins at approximately 97.1 at 1e7 TFLOPs, increases to approximately 99.7 at 3e7 TFLOPs, then declines to approximately 98.3 at 9e8 TFLOPs.
